work.title: Distri Rio
work.intro: Website and catalog for a distributor of candy, drinks, energy drinks, and supplements serving businesses in Rio and Baixada Fluminense.
work.shotHome: Distri Rio homepage on a computer
work.shotPhone: Distri Rio homepage on a phone
work.json: data/produtos.json holds the catalog. Example: Trident 5S, Mondelez, Mint, Spearmint, Tutti-Frutti.
work.pages: A Node script generates 333 product pages and 19 brand pages from the same JSON file.
work.search: Search by name, press Ctrl+K to open it, and filter by section or brand.
work.order: The order list becomes a WhatsApp message. First, it asks for a business tax ID, name, and WhatsApp number.
work.orderMessage: Hi! I’d like to place an order…
work.deploy: On every push, GitHub Actions checks the build, links, images, and flows in headless Chrome.
work.seconds: seconds to publish on GitHub Pages
work.more: It also has technical SEO (sitemap and structured data), an email form for job applications, measurement cookies only after consent (LGPD), and 9 main pages.
